name: Advance balance is transferred to the owner's capital dues in one click
title: SC-09-06-02 Advance balance is transferred to the owner's capital dues in one click
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a unit has an advance balance and an accrued capital due of the owner
When the advance is transferred to the capital dues from the payment tracking screen
Then the capital due is settled from the advance with an audit log entry
